snippet.title: The Dark Cowboy | Official Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
👉 Play the FREE DEMO and Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2530530/The_Dark_Cowboy/

Embark on a harrowing first-person horror adventure through untamed pine forests and deep caves. Track the Blackwood gang to avenge your family, but beware: outlaws aren't the only threat. In this physical, brutal, and indifferent world, the line between man and monster blurs.

Cling to the light, survive otherworldly nightmares, and keep your lantern burning. When the lantern flickers, remember: you aren’t the hunter. The nightmares hunt you.

🏜️ PLAY THE DEMO NOW:
Experience the first taste of the darkness. Download the demo directly from our Steam page and leave your feedback in the Community Hub!

🔦 KEY FEATURES:

    Living Frontier: Explore a majestic wilderness that slowly fractures into cosmic horror.
    Tactile World: Survive a brutal frontier by physically interacting with your surroundings. Lift, drag, and force your way forward.
    Relentless Nightmares: Face otherworldly Lovecraftian horrors that don't just haunt the dark—they hunt you.
    Environmental Puzzles: Solve intricate mechanical challenges to reveal the frontier’s hidden secrets.
    Cinematic Journey: Witness an epic blockbuster experience crafted with next-gen technology in Unreal Engine.

🔗 LINKS & SOCIALS:
• 🌐 Official Website: https://thedarkcowboy.com/
• 🎮 Steam Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2530530/The_Dark_Cowboy/

If you enjoyed the trailer, please leave a LIKE, SUBSCRIBE for more updates, and don't forget to add the game to your Steam Wishlist. It helps solo indie developers immensely! 🤠
